newsitem.title: USA: Maine education committee wants more school aid.
newsitem.headline: Maine education committee wants more school aid.

text.p: NEW YORK, Feb 4 (Reuter) Members of the Maine Legislature's education committee are urging lawmakers to increase aid to local school districts.
Gov Angus King has proposed a one-percent increase in the first year of the two-year budget, followed by a two-percent increase in the second year.
But the education committee wants a three-percent rise per year at a cost of $50 million. The panel also wants more money for higher education.

The increases are opposed by members of the Appropriations Committee, who say there simply is not enough money to provide all the increases the education committee wants. Some lawmakers say if the aid is not increased, more than half of all local school districts will get less money than they do now.
